title.narrative: Railway Energy Efficiency and Safety Enhancement Investment Program - Tranche 3

description.narrative: Tranche 3 of Investment Program will finance (i) procurement of energy efficient, environmental protection, and safety equipment that will result in energy savings, environmental protection, and enhanced safety. Physical components of Tranche 3 are (i) energy efficiency component: (a) railway electrification equipment, and (b) electric power supply system; (ii) environmental protection component: (a) noise barrier; and (iii) railway safety enhancement component: (a) enhanced railway fasteners and switches, (b) railway telecommunications system, (c) railway signaling system, (d) advanced railway inspection equipment, and (e) emergency rescue equipment, and any other equipment as agreed between PRC and ADB. This equipment has significant energy efficiency, environmental, and safety benefits 0d to what is used currently on the PRC railways. Integrating this equipment into the southwestern PRC railway network will help optimize performance, ensure reliability, and enhance safety.

title.narrative: Loan 2765: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: The section from Chengdu East station to Chongqing North station (about 288 km) has been in operation since 26 December 2015 and to Shapingba station has been in operation since 26 January 2018.
The final liquidation and refund of balance of advance account was done. The loan was financially closed on 30 December 2019.

Status of Implementation Progress: Railway electrification equipment package have been awarded in 2014 and installed by 2015.
Electric power supply package have been awarded in 2014 and installed by 2015.
Noise barriers package have been awarded and installed by 2015.
The contract were sign in May 2013 and installed by 2015.
The telecommunications package have been awarded in 2014 and installed by 2015.
Contract of $3.5 Million was awarded in June 2012, and the rest 2 lots were awarded in 2014 and installed by 2015.
Advanced railway inspection equipment pakcage have been awarded in 2013 and installed by 2015.
OCS maintenance car was procured in 2015.
